clue.text: 8's thieves trapping birds, one caught, snared by Her Majesty

definitions.note: 8 across is ELGAR's surname, so this stands for one of his works

indicators.note: trapping means the word for thieves closes round everything else

parts.note: thieves are takers of what is not theirs

indicators.note: snared by means the birds, one and caught sit inside the royal abbreviation

parts.note: emus are large flightless birds
the Roman numeral for one is I
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Robbers in a composer's world catch some birds, only to be snared by the Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Her Majesty' is the royal abbreviation, not a definition; the definition is just '8's', meaning a work by the composer at 8 across.
explanation.definitionFit: The Music Makers is a cantata by Edward Elgar, so it is one of the composer's works.

clue.text: enmark? Rest here

definitions.meaning: Denmark printed without its D: a country of no D, read as a phrase about sleep's realm
a place of rest is the imaginary country of sleep

explanation.walkthrough: The clue's first word is deliberately 'Denmark' with its D removed: a land lacking D is a land 'of no D'.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverbial realm of sleep, from Genesis, is a playful idiom for a place where people rest.

clue.text: See 25
Acts of rebellion America's forcing through

indicators.note: through means the forcing word passes right inside the abbreviation

parts.note: US is the abbreviation for America (the United States)
prising is forcing open with a lever

explanation.surface: An observation on how America brings about revolts by pushing its way in.
explanation.definitionFit: Uprisings are revolts, synonyms for acts of rebellion against authority.

clue.text: Firmly set with home team up, sent outside

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: outside means the word for sent is placed round the reversed team

parts.note: fed means passed or sent on, as a ball is fed to a player

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the team word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: XI is a team of eleven, as in cricket or football

explanation.surface: Something is fixed solidly after the home side goes up and a player is sent off.
explanation.definitionFit: Infixed means fastened in place, a synonym of firmly set.

clue.text: Drip surgery uses overhead

indicators.note: overhead means in this down clue the word for uses sits above the surgery

parts.note: milks means exploits or uses
OP is short for operation, surgery

explanation.surface: A surgery's running costs are being exploited, by the sound of it.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'overhead' puts MILKS above OP.
explanation.definitionFit: A drip is a feeble, wet person, exactly what a milksop is.

clue.text: Boat, or old chopper

definitions.meaning: Jack ... was a notorious 17th-century executioner, so the name came to mean a hangman or axeman

explanation.definitionFit: A ketch is a sailing boat, and Jack Ketch, the executioner, gave his name to old axemen.

clue.text: Overhaul regarding controversial habit again beginning to help

parts.note: re means regarding or about
fur is clothing whose wearing is controversial; habit means dress
bis means twice or again, as called for an encore

indicators.note: beginning to means take only the first letter of help

explanation.surface: Someone is to overhaul a disputed religious garment, again starting to help.
explanation.definitionFit: To refurbish something is to renovate or overhaul it.

clue.text: Romantic line in fashion making comeback

indicators.note: making comeback means the whole construction is read backwards
in means the line letter is put inside the fashion word

parts.note: rage means a craze or fashion, all the rage

explanation.surface: A romantic style is returning to vogue.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes into RAGE to make RAGLE, which 'making comeback' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar was a composer of the late Romantic period, so a Romantic is a fair label.

clue.text: 8's son dividing rivers

definitions.note: 8 across is ELGAR, so this is one of his works

indicators.note: dividing means the son letter splits the two river names

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall
the Taff is a river in Wales

explanation.surface: A composer's son splits two waterways.
explanation.definitionFit: Falstaff is Elgar's symphonic study about Shakespeare's fat knight, so it is the composer's work.

clue.text: Formal wear for a wedding, or for a funeral, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear signals that a phrase sounds the same as the one entered

parts.note: black clothing worn in grief is mourning dress

explanation.surface: A question about which suit of clothes suits both happy and sad occasions.
explanation.definitionFit: Morning dress, with tailcoat, is the traditional formal attire for daytime weddings in Britain.

clue.text: Instrument left to it, breaking short tool

indicators.note: breaking means the other pieces split the shortened tool
short means drop the tool's final letter

parts.note: an axe is a cutting tool
taken as written
it means sex appeal, abbreviated SA

explanation.surface: A musician leaves things to a broken tool.
explanation.definitionFit: The alto sax is a saxophone pitched in E flat, a common musical instrument.

clue.text: Brisk movement leading man round two sharp corners east of South Carolina

indicators.note: east of means in this across clue the following comes to the right of the state

parts.note: SC is the abbreviation for the US state of South Carolina

indicators.note: round means the leading man goes about the sharp letter

parts.note: the hero is the leading man of a story
the letter Z is drawn with two sharp bends

explanation.surface: A lively piece of music featuring a star rounding sharp bends in South Carolina.
explanation.definitionFit: A scherzo is a quick, playful movement in a symphony or sonata.

clue.text: Half eat, then drink, then eat!

indicators.note: half means only half of the word for eat is kept

parts.note: dine means eat
gin is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Instructions for a meal: eat a bit, then drink, then eat some more.
explanation.definitionFit: Dig in is an informal imperative to start eating, inviting people to tuck in.

clue.text: More surly, pained expression, one between royal father and daughter

indicators.note: between means the expression and one sit between the two ciphers

parts.note: GR and ER are the royal ciphers of George VI and his daughter Elizabeth II
ouch is a cry of pain
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A grumpier sound of pain comes from a member of the royal family between king and princess.
explanation.walkthrough: GR is George Rex and ER Elizabeth Regina, the ciphers of George VI and his daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Grouchier is the comparative of grouchy, so it means grumpier or more surly.

clue.text: Way of talking about record's image

indicators.note: about means the way of talking wraps round the record

parts.note: diction is a manner of speaking
EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A speech style talking about the image on a record sleeve.
explanation.definitionFit: A depiction is a representation, a picture or image of something.

clue.text: 8's male, single, clutched by girl endlessly

definitions.note: 8 across is ELGAR, so this is one of his works

parts.note: a cock is a male bird

indicators.note: clutched by means the single letter sits inside the shortened girl's name
endlessly means the girl's name loses its final letter

parts.note: Agnes is a girl's name
I is one, single

explanation.surface: A composer's male friend, single, is gripped by a girl who never stops.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockaigne (In London Town) is a concert overture by Elgar, so it is one of his works.

clue.text: 8's right — nothing is close to brass among wind

definitions.note: 8 across is ELGAR, so this is one of his works

indicators.note: among means the other pieces sit inside the wind word

parts.note: a fart is wind, flatulence
nothing is zero, the letter O
taken as written

indicators.note: close to means take the last letter of brass

explanation.surface: In a band, a composer's right-hand man is near the brass among the wind section.
explanation.definitionFit: Froissart is a concert overture by Elgar, named after the medieval chronicler.

clue.text: Sweetheart is tempted to hug entertainer

indicators.note: to hug means the letters are held inside the run of words

explanation.surface: A lover is tempted to embrace a performer.
explanation.definitionFit: An artiste is a professional performer such as a singer or dancer, an entertainer.

clue.text: Time to put out sweet

parts.note: to ruffle someone is to put them out, upset them

explanation.surface: Time to throw away a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: A truffle is a soft chocolate confection, a type of sweet.

clue.text: Leonard, one of the 1 acrosses, man in blue

indicators.note: in means the man sits inside the blue word

parts.note: blue is the Conservative colour, so a Con, a Tory
he is a male pronoun, a man

explanation.surface: Leonard, a musician, is a man dressed in blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonard Cohen was a singer-songwriter, so a music maker, the subject of 1 across.

clue.text: Oxygen capacity I set for the back of the head

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
cc, cubic centimetres, measures capacity
to set something down is to put it

explanation.surface: Oxygen capacity is fixed for the rear of the skull.
explanation.definitionFit: The occiput is the anatomical term for the back part of the head.

clue.text: Under great pressure, turning new nut

indicators.note: turning means the great word and the letter below it are read the other way
under means in this down clue the pressure letter goes below the great word

parts.note: ace means great, excellent

explanation.surface: A nut cracks under great pressure, turning new.
explanation.walkthrough: P under ACE gives ACEP, which 'turning' makes PECA before N.
explanation.definitionFit: The pecan is a nut from a North American hickory tree.

clue.text: University called to maintain resistance, though can't do so?

definitions.note: a clause meaning cannot put up resistance, standing for a defenceless adjective

indicators.note: to maintain means the called word holds the resistance letter

parts.note: named means called
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A university is said to keep up resistance, though it cannot.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers back to the wordplay: someone who cannot maintain resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without weapons, someone defenceless is unable to fight back or resist.

clue.text: Descartes' considered conclusion passing through northern state to southern city

indicators.note: passing through means the conclusion goes inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: MI is the abbreviation for Michigan, a northern US state
Descartes concluded I think, therefore I am

explanation.surface: A philosopher's reasoning passes through the north to a city in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: Miami is a city in Florida, in the southern United States.

clue.text: A description here of 1 across, 9, 16 and 17?

definitions.text: A description here of 1 across, 9, 16 and 17?

parts.words: A description here of 1 across, 9, 16 and 17?
parts.note: the four answers are compositions by the composer at 8 across, read alongside the pirate coin phrase

explanation.walkthrough: The four answers are compositions, so works of the composer at 8, who is linked to the number by his clue number.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish dollar coins of pirate lore also serve as works of the composer whose grid number is that figure.

clue.text: 25 2 dazzle

indicators.note: pieces of means the following is broken into a new order

parts.note: the eighth answer, the composer at 8 across, is meant by the figure

explanation.surface: Bits of coinage glitter.
explanation.walkthrough: '25 2' reads PIECES OF EIGHT: 'pieces of' is the anagram signal and 'eight' points to 8 across, ELGAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To glare is to shine dazzlingly bright, so glare and dazzle are synonyms.

clue.text: Extras at the Edinburgh Festival?

parts.note: perks of a job, read as charity shows staged on the alternative fringe in Edinburgh

explanation.walkthrough: The Edinburgh Fringe is the open-access arts festival held alongside the official Edinburgh Festival.
explanation.definitionFit: Perks given on top of salary are extras, the same idea as job perks.
